groups.name: Young and Stretched
groups.description: Around 39, with more debt than they have built up in assets.
groups.why: Cash buffer first, with low-cost stock exposure as they build up.

groups.name: Cautious Near-Retirees
groups.description: Around 60, modest income, very little cash, and no appetite for risk.
groups.why: Protects what they have and guards against inflation.

groups.name: Established Retirees
groups.description: Around 70, wealthy, lots of cash, and no debt.
groups.why: Preserves wealth and takes income from bonds.

groups.name: Growing While Paying Debt
groups.description: Around 50, high income, mostly stocks, and heavy debt.
groups.why: Already growth-heavy, so the mix adds diversification abroad and a bond cushion.

groups.name: Ready but Uninvested
groups.description: Around 45, solid income, willing to take risk, but almost none of it in stocks.
groups.why: Their comfort with risk matches a stock-heavy start.
